top_signals.title: US to Make Some Dark Fleet Ships Legitimate, Wright Says
top_signals.summary: The US will turn some "dark fleet" oil tankers into legitimate ships that can legally carry crude, says Energy Secretary Chris Wright. He says investors will refurbish some ships and have them carry non-sanctioned oil. He speaks to Bloomberg's Annmarie Hordern at a Citadel Securities event in New York. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: APC Expands in Middle East, Europe
top_signals.summary: Advanced Polymer Coatings (APC) expanded its international maritime sales team with two appointments.James Kennedy has been appointed to lead sales across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries, including Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait and Oman.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: OpenAI bugging case: Saudi consulate offers to pay bail for suspect
top_signals.summary: Saudi national Abdulrahman Alfozan is accused of planting a recording device in an executive conference room at OpenAI headquarters in San Francisco.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
